quote: We collect annotations from both expert and non-expert annotators on text sampled from three moderation ecosystems...
We collect annotations from both expert moderators and non-expert crowdworkers, with different task designs tailored to each group.
guideline: We collect annotations... with labels covering need for moderation, type of intervention, and contributing discourse properties (e.g., clarity, constructiveness, tone).

The annotation interface and instructions prioritized interpretive depth over annotation speed. Tasks capturing: (1) moderation necessity; (2) priority/urgency; (3) appropriate moderation function(s); and (4) contributing quality properties.
